시편 128:1.content: A Song of degrees. Blessed is every one that feareth the Lord; that walketh in his ways.

시편 128:2.content: For thou shalt eat the labour of thine hands: happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

시편 128:3.content: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of thine house: thy children like olive plants round about thy table.

시편 128:4.content: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that feareth the Lord.

시편 128:5.content: The Lord shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

시편 128:6.content: Yea, thou shalt see thy children’s children, and peace upon Israel.
